results.title: One by one all Nigerians will see the light.

One by one all Nigerians will see the light. 
USA doesn’t care about Nigeria or Nigerians. 
They never have and never will. 
Even the cooperation he commended the Nigerian government for has to do with the mineral deal USA signed this year not with seriousness in tackling any insecurity. 
Go and read the terms of the minerals deal worth $700b you will understand the game USA is playing. They used the Christian’s massacre(an insecurity the USA is indirectly sponsoring) story to cajole our govt into signing it, this doesn’t mean that if we have a serious govt we can’t defeat insecurity. We can. 
Nigerians We are the only ones who can save ourselves. And it can only be done through a revolution.
